claim: The existing RFC runtime and search-budget gates are offline tests. A named deployment and raw deployed SSE ARE now observed on the merge preview. A provider request id is still not observed -- and that is a property of the code, not of the round: nothing in the shipped path ever reads one.

rawSse.what: the gold fatwa turn as the deployed preview streamed it, captured whole before assembly

externalEvidence.reason: measured on the merge preview of 2026-08-15; acceptanceGreen stays false because two of this fixture's own required fields are still unobtainable, and the bar is not lowered to the evidence that happened to be reachable

blocked.upstashTransaction: no transaction id is printed anywhere: lib/ledger/daily-budget.js logs nothing. The reservation was still observed BY EFFECT -- a Brave call cannot run unless reserve() returns ok -- and that effect is recorded in the G-06 fixture rather than dressed up as an id here
blocked.braveRequestId: lib/ledger/search.js reads only the results body from the Brave response; no request id is read, logged or returned, so there is no value to capture without changing shipped code
blocked.anthropicRequestId: the stream the client receives is server-finalized -- its message id is the literal 'server-finalized' -- and the deployed code logs no upstream id, so the provider id never leaves the vendor call
